en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet town street. The scene shows a gently curving main road lined with two‑ and three‑storey buildings with steep tiled roofs and decorative facades. On the right is a larger civic-looking building marked as the town hall and post office; on the left are residential houses and fences. A child with a small cart or pram stands in the middle of the street, while a few adults walk along the sidewalks. The printed caption at the top in red German text identifies the location as Grünhainichen, specifically the main street with the town hall and post office.
